scope: Source-backed appearance refinement after native geometry installation

sourceReferences.owner: Hutchison Estate Agents Limited / The Whampoa
sourceReferences.inspected: 2026-09-09 Asia/Hong_Kong; live page screenshot inspected, not bundled as an app texture
observations: Pale hull and upper decks under warm external illumination.
Continuous blue/cyan glazing band around the front upper superstructure, not a rectangular apartment window grid.
Thin dark horizontal bow stripes and name lettering.
Warm point lights and mast/rigging string-light lines at night.
sourceReferences.limits: Night lighting and photographic white balance do not establish an exact daytime paint RGB, current repaint date, lettering layout dimensions or a lighting operating schedule.

sourceReferences.observation: Official text confirms the cruise-liner landmark. Two referenced photographs failed to load in the browser; no visual claims taken from those unavailable images.

nativeMaterialInspection.existingViewerMechanism: Source material clone plus lighting hook and proceduralWindows switch; no verified per-face appearance mask or Whampoa-specific source material tags.

decision: Do not apply a whole-model cream or cyan tint: the same native material spans hull/decks/glazing and would miscolour unrelated surfaces. Preserve source assets and disabled generic window grids. Build an explicitly derived, SHA-bound material-mask sidecar after matching source faces to clear daylight references; keep original model bytes intact.
nextTasks: Obtain at least two clear dated/source-attributed daylight bow and side views; verify current hull/deck paint, glazing boundaries and legible name/stripes.
Map only confirmed source face groups to hull, glazing and trim. Store model SHA, triangle membership and evidence URLs; unmatched faces retain native material.

Apply derived material overrides without changing vertices, bounds, collision, source IDs, elevations or fallback behaviour. Do not project a third-party photograph as a texture without a suitable reuse licence.
Model mast and rigging lights only where their source geometry/positions support it, with a separately documented approximate lighting schedule rather than claiming live operation.
Capture the same unobstructed normal-scene desktop/mobile day/night views and measure incremental draw calls, texture bytes and frame cost before acceptance.
